admin.flatpakNothing: Flatpak found nothing it considers unused. Runtimes you installed yourself are pinned and are never removed automatically; uninstall them with: flatpak uninstall <name>
admin.missing: Bosun's administrator helper isn't installed. Install the .deb package, or run this in the Bosun folder:
admin.passwordNote: Your system will ask for your password. Bosun never sees it.
admin.undoHint: You can undo this from Settings.
ai.baseUrlHint: Any OpenAI-compatible server. For a local Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1
ai.keyPrivacy: It's stored only in your config file (readable by you alone) and never shown again.
ai.keySaved: A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
ai.providerHint: Who answers in the Chat tab. ✓ means a key is saved.
chat.askCpu: What is keeping the CPU busy?
chat.askDisk: {mount} is almost full. What can I safely remove?
chat.askHeat: Why is my computer running hot?
chat.askLeak: {app} keeps using more memory. Should I restart it?
chat.askReclaim: Is it safe to clean what Bosun found?
chat.needKeyBody: Monitoring, findings and cleanup all work without one. To talk to Bosun, pick a provider (Claude, Grok, Gemini, OpenAI or a local model) and add its API key in Settings.
chat.s2: Help me free up disk space
chat.s3: Why might my computer be slow?
chat.welcome: What would you like to know?
chat.welcomeBody: Bosun answers from your system's live readings. If it suggests removing something, it shows you an approval card first.
clean.groupAdmin: Needs administrator rights · Bosun asks for your password first
clean.groupLarge: Large files in Downloads · only the ones you tick are removed
clean.groupUser: Areas Bosun can clean for you
clean.locked: {n} more ({size}) can't be removed: {dirs} belongs to another user, usually because a program ran with sudo. Give it back to yourself, then rescan:
clean.orTerminal: Or run it in a terminal
clean.scanningLong: Scanning the disk, this can take a few seconds…
clean.selected: {n} selected · you'll see the details before anything happens
clean.title: Cleanup
clean.truncated: Only the first {n} {n|item|items} are listed; the real size may be larger.
crash.hint: The rest of Bosun keeps working. If this keeps happening, copy the details and send them along.
crash.title: This screen ran into a problem
disk.intro: What takes up space in your home folder. Bosun only measures here. A file can go to the trash, but only after you approve the plan.
disk.measuring: Measuring… the first look at a large folder can take a while.
disk.name: Name
disk.title: Disk usage
disk.unreadable: {n} {n|folder|folders} couldn't be read and {n|is|are} not counted.
helper.fromSource: Installed from source code instead? Run this in the Bosun folder:
helper.missing: Bosun's administrator helper isn't installed ({path}). Reinstalling the package puts it back:
helper.not_a_file: {path} exists but isn't a regular file. Reinstall the package:
helper.not_root_owned: {path} isn't owned by root, so Bosun won't give it administrator rights. Fix its ownership:
helper.writable_by_others: {path} can be modified by other users, so Bosun won't give it administrator rights. Fix its permissions:
history.dryRun: Dry run: {size} could have been freed
history.intro: Cleanups, administrator actions and startup changes, newest first.
history.proposed: Plan suggested in chat, not applied
history.title: History
offline.banner: The Bosun service isn't reachable. Showing the last known readings.
offline.body: The app couldn't connect to the background service that watches your system. Start it and the app will reconnect on its own.
offline.title: The Bosun service isn't running
overview.adviceHint: Apply here (asks for your password) or run the command yourself
overview.allGoodBody: Nothing in disk, memory or services needs attention.
overview.noAdvice: No settings to suggest right now.
plan.intro: Here is what you picked. Nothing is removed until you approve.
plan.partlyPermanent: some of it will be deleted permanently
plan.permanentWarning: The trash will be emptied. These files cannot be recovered.
plan.skipped: {n} {n|item was|items were} skipped because they failed the safety check.
plan.title: Cleanup plan
settings.appliedHint: System settings Bosun changed for you
settings.appliedNone: Bosun hasn't changed any system settings.
settings.configHint: API key, thresholds and scan intervals live here. Restart the service after editing.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Copies versions, service status and recent log lines. API keys are never included.
settings.helperMissing: Not installed. System cleanups are shown as commands you can run yourself.
settings.helperOk: Installed. Bosun can clean system files after asking for your password.
settings.languageHint: Used for the app, notifications and Bosun's replies.
settings.notificationsHint: Desktop alerts for full disks, high memory, heat and failed services.
settings.offline: Settings are saved by the service. Start it to change them.
settings.persistChatHint: Keeps the conversation after the service restarts (stored only on this computer).
settings.privacy: File paths shared with the AI provider
settings.privacyHint: When on, Bosun can tell the AI the names of large files in Downloads. File contents are never sent.
settings.title: Settings
settings.weeklySummaryHint: Once a week, if more than 1 GB can be freed, a notification says how much. Nothing is removed until you approve.
startup.count: {on} of {total} start when you log in
startup.essentialHint: Part of the desktop; turning it off could break things.
startup.lede: Apps that start with your session. Turning one off removes nothing: Bosun writes a copy to ~/.config/autostart that you can turn back on here.
startup.title: Startup apps
version.mismatch: The background service is version {service}, but the app is {app}. Restart the service to finish the update.
version.oldService: The background service is older than the app. Restart it to use these settings.
